==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the Day)
:'''Qinghe:''' Hey, what is a little cat doing in the pool?!
:'''Qinghe:''' Don't panic, kitty-kitty. I'll get you out of there right now!
:'''Xiaotang:''' Please keep it down. The cat doesn't like loud noises when it's enjoying the hot spring.
:'''Xiaotang:''' Oh, and it's name is Tiger, not kitty.
:'''Qinghe:''' Enjoying the hot spring? Stop messing with me, little girl. All cats hate water.
:'''Xiaotang:''' I'm not messing with you. Cats in Mt. Firmament don't.
:'''Xiaotang:''' Well, that's not entirely true, I guess... They don't like the streams. Maybe they just prefer Sagaci Springs...
:'''Xiaotang:''' Hey, look, Tiger heard us and is swimming our way!
:'''Qinghe:''' That is odd. The cat does seem fine and well...
----
;(At Night)
:'''Qinghe:'''  Interesting... I wouldn't believe it if I didn't see it for myself.
:'''Qinghe:''' I wonder what makes Sagaci Springs so special...
:'''Qinghe:''' Maybe I should try it myself sometime?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
Although their name says Yuhe, it turns Qinghe when spoken to.
